Package org.ddolib.examples.layered.misp

Class MispDominanceChecker

java.lang.Object
org.ddolib.layered.modeling.DominanceChecker<BitSet>
org.ddolib.examples.layered.misp.MispDominanceChecker
public class MispDominanceChecker extends DominanceChecker<BitSet>
Dominance checker of the Maximum Independent Set Problem (MISP), for the MispDominance relation: a state is dominated by a state with a better or equal value whose set of remaining vertices includes its own.

The dominance by inclusion forbids grouping the states by a key (see MispDominance.getKey(java.util.BitSet)), so that a SimpleDominanceChecker compares each new state with all the states of its layer. This checker groups the states of a layer by their number of remaining vertices instead: a set can only be included in a set with at least as many vertices. A new state is thus only compared with the states having at least as many remaining vertices to know if it is dominated, and with the states having at most as many remaining vertices to remove the ones it dominates.

It prunes exactly the same states as a SimpleDominanceChecker with a MispDominance. The states are not copied: they must not be modified after their creation, which is the case of the states built by MispProblem.transition(java.util.BitSet, org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.Decision).
